svg.text: The Graphic and Geometric Suite
Measure a codebase, draw it, and only then change it, on one fifty-two rung ladder in three
bands: the surveyor moves nothing, the architect declares bounds and rewrites nothing, the
renovator changes only against a survey and a plan that exist on disk.
/codebase-architect-dtd [the survey json to stand on, or blank for the latest under artifacts/geometry; --no-gate runs autonomously; --verbose prints the measure behind every bound]
55 laws
DTD-native: declare what the shape of a codebase should be, standing on a survey, and
rewrite nothing. Band II of the fifty-two rung Graphic and Geometric ladder (orthography
to apparatus): every projection declares a bound a later survey is held to, the plan
names the survey it stands on by path, its figure is the survey's with the projections
added, and node lib/geometry.mjs plan --check names every bound a survey exceeds. Gates
on the scope before it declares a line
/codebase-renovator-dtd [the survey markdown and the plan markdown to stand on, in that order; --no-gate runs autonomously; --verbose prints the digest of each precondition]
55 laws
DTD-native: change the standing structure of a codebase, only against a survey that
exists and a plan declared first. Band III of the fifty-two rung Graphic and Geometric
ladder (rectification to diplomatics): the engine refuses by name a renovation missing
its survey or its plan, every change names its file with the shape before and after, the
record closes with a colophon and the digests it stands on, and the changed tree is
certified leg by leg. Gates before the first change
/codebase-surveyor-dtd [a path to survey, or blank for the current repository; --no-gate runs autonomously; --verbose prints the evidence behind every measure]
55 laws
DTD-native: measure a codebase and draw it, and move nothing. Band I of the fifty-two
rung Graphic and Geometric ladder (planimetry to conspectus): every instrumented rung is
measured in the foreground under its ceiling, every measure names its instrument, unit
and seconds, the rungs without one are named unmeasured, one figure is drawn from the
numbers, and the survey is written under artifacts/geometry for the architect to stand
on. Gates on the scope before it draws a line
